deep_dive.title: WaveMark: Robust Wavelet-Domain Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models
deep_dive.abstract: Image watermarking enables provenance tracing for photorealistic images generated by diffusion models. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) removal attacks can suppress embedded signals with little perceptual degradation. This vulnerability limits the effectiveness of watermarks for intellectual property protection and misuse attribution. We propose WaveMark, a novel wavelet-domain watermarking method that embeds messages in a diffusion model's initial noise. To support robust recovery from perturbed carriers, WaveMark distributes keyed replicas of message bits across spatial positions, wavelet orientations, and scales. Each carrier groups coefficients from four latent channels and encodes a randomized bit through magnitude projection, providing an explicit decoding margin. We evaluate WaveMark with SD2.1 on SDP and MS-COCO Captions under 14 attacks. WaveMark achieves 100.0% bit accuracy (BA) without attacks, while maintaining image quality comparable to the evaluated baselines. Under SOTA MarkNull and MarkNull-A, it retains over 88% BA, outperforming all baselines.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对扩散模型生成图像的水印易被先进去除攻击抹除、视觉退化却很小，从而威胁版权保护与来源追溯的问题，本文提出WaveMark小波域水印方法。该方法将消息嵌入扩散模型的初始噪声，通过幅度投影把密钥比特副本跨空间位置、小波方向与尺度分布，使每个载体编码随机比特，从而在被扰动后仍能稳健恢复。实验表明WaveMark在去除攻击下保持鲁棒且不可感知，为生成图像的来源认证与知识产权保护提供更强保障。

quick_skim.title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
quick_skim.abstract: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: AI-generated image detectors trained on fixed generator domains degrade as new generators appear, and replaying old data is costly. EvoKnow evolves a shared forensic basis with residual experts and a closed-form incremental router to detect continually without replay.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对AI生成图像检测器在固定生成域训练、新生成模型出现后性能下降且回放历史数据成本高昂的问题，本文提出免回放的EvoKnow框架。方法将持续检测表述为取证知识演化，保留从基础域学到的共享取证基，增量添加隔离的残差专家以补充新生成器证据，并通过闭式更新的解析增量路由器检索知识。实验表明该方法在持续学习设定下缓解灾难性遗忘，保持对历史与新增生成域的检测能力。该工作为生成模型不断演化场景下的图像真伪鉴别提供了可扩展方案。
